description: Returns a one-time Stripe Checkout URL to hand the user so they can add a payment card. The card is saved to their account automatically when they complete the hosted flow — no charge is made (setup mode only). Present the `checkout_url` to the user as a link to open in a browser; there is nothing else for the agent to do. Buyer principals only. Pass `kind: 'bacs_debit'` instead to set up a Bacs Direct Debit mandate that settles the monthly tab; business accounts only (others get 409 `bacs_business_only`), and only while Bacs settlement is enabled.

kind.description: What to set up: a payment card (the default), or a Bacs Direct Debit mandate. Direct Debit is for business accounts only and settles the monthly tab.
